Question: Larry and Julius are playing a game, taking turns throwing a ball at a bottle sitting on a ledge. Larry throws first. The winner is the first person to knock the bottle off the ledge. At each turn the probability that a player knocks the bottle off the ledge is \(\dfrac12,\) independently of what has happened before. What is the probability that Larry wins the game?
